policy: Data availability, feature tests and complete-model validation are separate decisions. A rejected feature does not block a simpler model, but no complete forecast may be authorised without out-of-sample probability calibration.

demographicChallenger.label: Demographic challenger failed its sealed promotion test and remains excluded

completeForecastBacktest.label: Complete multi-party seat model passes walk-forward backtesting

probabilityCalibration.label: Published win probabilities pass reliability and coverage tests
